== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Children of Nakothi]] are monstrous, mindless entities born from the intersection of human remains and the power of the [[Great Elder]] [[Nakothi]]. These creatures are formed when her influence embeds itself into corpses, effectively repurposing human parts into specialized workers or abominations. While they are composed of stolen flesh and bone, their physical forms vary wildly; some appear as blobs of blubber or fused masses of drowned men, while others are titanic, multi-limbed horrors with shifting, pulpy heads. They possess a simple, focused intelligence driven by a primal [[hunger]] and are capable of consuming prey over several days. These beings inhabit the warped, corpse-like island where [[Nakothi]]'s body fell after her defeat. They are summoned to battle and guided by the calls of their [[Handmaiden]], a massive figure that towers over the island's trees. Though they act as drones or minions, they are dangerous enough to swarm entire groups and hunt specific targets. Some accounts suggest [[Nakothi]] views the creation of these creatures as a way to improve humanity by warping their bodies, though they are widely regarded as hideous abominations.}}
